name: taiga-front-cloud
install: if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; nvm install 16.19.1; nvm use 16.19.1; fi; npm ci; if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; nvm install 22; nvm use 22; fi; npm --prefix web-react ci

terminals.name: angular
terminals.command: if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; nvm use 16.19.1; fi; npm start

terminals.name: react
terminals.command: if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22; fi; npm run react
